The night shift lead said it hangs when a Quarendon Freightways driver arrives with a split manifest. That thread is also where the account name got confused with Tansley Parcel, and Hollis corrected it.

The share has no files for this account, and I didn't check whether the ticket is still open. A ticket number is an operational fact under the rules, not a finance figure, so it can go in #central-random.
